title: TriageResult
description: What a triage Job answers, as the last framed block of its log: the labels it chose, and an analysis and plan of the issue a person reads before working on it.

outcome.description: triaged = the model answered with labels and an analysis that passed the schema.

labels.description: Names from the request's labels. Hephaisto puts on only those the repository has.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the issue asks for.

analysis.description: Markdown: where the change lies, what it touches, what is risky, what is unclear.

steps.description: The plan, in the order a person would work it.

questions.description: What only a person can decide, each with what the plan assumed meanwhile.

cost_usd.description: The SDK's total_cost_usd; notional on a subscription.

billing.description: Which credential paid: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN = subscription, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = api, the fake SDK = fake.
